title: Blue Mountain Beach 143 Seaward Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf front- Gated community- Low-Speed Vehicle- 5 adult bikes provided- In-home gym- 3 available parking spaces- Complete Clean Linen Participant—ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: 143 Seaward Drive is a Gulf-front 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom home in a gated community that sleeps 17. Guests will enjoy watching dolphins from 2 spacious balconies in the morning and the convenience of an included 6-passenger golf cart.Guests staying on the first floor will enjoy a spacious bunk room with multiple bunk beds, a wet bar, and quick access to the dune walkover and beach.An open living, dining, and kitchen area enjoy stunning Gulf views through multiple French doors that open to a long Gulf-front balcony. After a busy day jumping waves, guests can relax in front of a 65” TV in the living area or prepare fresh-caught fish in the beautiful kitchen. Marble countertops, a 4-burner gas range, and premium appliances provide everything guests need. A dine-in island and an adjacent dining table with bench seating keep the conversation flowing while meals are prepared. A bunkroom off the living area has a twin-over-twin bunk bed.On the third floor are 2 guest bedrooms and a primary bedroom that enjoys private access to a Gulf-front balcony through double French doors.Guests will love the convenience of this 30A beach home! 143 Seaward Drive is close to shops, restaurants, a golf course, and a yoga studio. 5 adult bikes make it simple to explore the 30A bike path, or guests can take the included 6-passenger golf cart to dinner and leave the car behind. With this fabulous location, 143 Seaward Drive won’t be available for long. body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Blue Mountain Beach 143 Seaward Drive Santa Rosa Beach, FL Bedrooms 5 Beds 12 Sleeps 17 Full Baths 4 Half Baths 0 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf front - Gated community - Low-Speed Vehicle - 5 adult bikes provided - In-home gym - 3 available parking spaces - Complete Clean Linen Participant—ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: 143 Seaward Drive is a Gulf-front 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom home in a gated community that sleeps 17. Guests will enjoy watching dolphins from 2 spacious balconies in the morning and the convenience of an included 6-passenger golf cart. Guests staying on the first floor will enjoy a spacious bunk room with multiple bunk beds, a wet bar, and quick access to the dune walkover and beach. An open living, dining, and kitchen area enjoy stunning Gulf views through multiple French doors that open to a long Gulf-front balcony. After a busy day jumping waves, guests can relax in front of a 65” TV in the living area or prepare fresh-caught fish in the beautiful kitchen. Marble countertops, a 4-burner gas range, and premium appliances provide everything guests need. A dine-in island and an adjacent dining table with bench seating keep the conversation flowing while meals are prepared. A bunkroom off the living area has a twin-over-twin bunk bed. On the third floor are 2 guest bedrooms and a primary bedroom that enjoys private access to a Gulf-front balcony through double French doors. Guests will love the convenience of this 30A beach home! 143 Seaward Drive is close to shops, restaurants, a golf course, and a yoga studio. 5 adult bikes make it simple to explore the 30A bike path, or guests can take the included 6-passenger golf cart to dinner and leave the car behind. With this fabulous location, 143 Seaward Drive won’t be available for long. Book today!
